sourceFacts.fact: PSGN is an immune-mediated delayed consequence of some group A streptococcal infections.
It is not direct streptococcal infection of the kidneys.

layout: Four large station cards left-to-right, exactly three forward arrows. First has textual tags Throat and Skin. Second shows a plain clock with the exact label After a latent interval. Third has a coral warning star. Fourth has tags Blood in urine, Oedema, Hypertension. Bottom caption: Delayed immune injury, not direct kidney infection. No day or week numbers, ranges, durations or limits anywhere. Do not print node identifiers or numerical badges. No kidney, cells or bacteria.
